correctness.rationale: Independent coordinate reflections force zero mean and off-diagonal covariance. Each orthant contributes the same volume; the unsigned conditional cross-section factors into the two polynomial tail volumes, yielding the exact rational ratio without a missing power of two. The kernel 1{x+y≤1} is symmetric and square-integrable. Direct integration gives the signed eigenvalues (−1)^k 2/((2k+1)π) on the complete mixed-boundary cosine basis, and the constant function has coefficient ratios (−1)^k/(2k+1). In the normalized numerator the two residual norms are bounded by C3^(−r) and C3^(−s); the denominator is 1 plus their inner product with r+s=n−1. This uniformly controls the bulk and justifies taking one tail to infinity. Product-to-sum gives the indicated off-leading inner products and thus the sign (−1)^{k(j+1)} in the boundary series. Odd j gives a positive strictly decreasing subsequence. For even j the alternating-series lower bound on the j=2 deficit uses a_1/9−a_2/25=7/90, exceeding the upper bound a_1/81=1/108 at all even j≥4. The k=1 coefficient has the asserted normalization and the remaining coefficient sum is O(5^(−j)). Integrating the first two marginals, proportional to cos(πx/2) and (1−x)cos(πx/2), gives the stated positive v_1,v_2. Reflection and subsequences either at a fixed depth or escaping from both ends then give the claimed extreme variance limits and ratio. The finite checker was inspected but is not used as proof.
residual_risks: The condition number is in the displayed Euclidean embedding for interior Lebesgue measure, not affine invariant or calculated for the positive-orthant covariance matrix.

originality.rationale: The supported distinct contribution is the sharp signed-polytope boundary variance comparison and resulting exact conditioning limit: it evaluates the signed spectral corrections, shows strict global extremizers of the limiting profile at depths 1 and 2, and controls the moving interior positions. The bulk second moment, slicing functions, and the ability to compute rational finite moments are covered ingredients, not independent grounds for novelty. The strongest inspected same-polytope result has explicit slice functions and even a uniform leading asymptotic; it implies the unevaluated boundary moment expression but does not already compare second-moment extrema. The extra signed coefficient calculation and uniform all-depth extremal comparison are needed.
residual_risks: An unindexed refinement of zigzag rank distributions or equivalent weighted endpoint estimates could cover the extremal comparison. The review does not claim historical uniqueness or originality of the finite marginal recursion or bulk density.
